Today, Apple TV released the trailer for the fifth season of 《Stillwater》, a Peabody and Emmy Award-winning series about mindfulness. Watch the trailer below.

《Stillwater》will return on August 21

A few days ago, Apple TV confirmed the premiere date for the fifth season of 《Stillwater》, with five episodes set to drop simultaneously on August 21.

According to Apple TV, the new season of 《Stillwater》will feature more 「breathing exercises, mindfulness moments, and simple everyday life practices」, continuing to help children and families find inner peace.

《Stillwater》premiered on Apple TV in 2020, and has won the Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Editing in a Pre-School Animated Program and the Peabody Award in the Children's/Youth Programming category.
